name: Fire Giant
description: A fire giant is a goliath creature infused with the blood of elemental fire. As with their other giant kin, these creatures typically fight in groups, using bellowing songs to coordinate their actions.

actions.name: Flaming Zweihander
actions.description: The fire giant swings their massive sword at a creature dealing physical and fire damage.

actions.name: Elder Song of Flame
actions.description: The fire giant sings out a booming chorus which downgrades all critical hits made against allies within 10 units be downgraded by one tier. This action requires the fire giant's focus and ends at the start of their next turn.

actions.name: Harmonize
actions.description: While in the range of an ally who is focusing on the Elder Song of Flame action, this fire giant gains a 1d4 bonus to bonus to their next attack check and the critical threshold is increased by 1.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: The fire giant makes an attack against a large or smaller creature, dealing physical damage. The creature must also make a concentration check against half the damage taken after mitigation or become stunned.

actions.name: Channel Flame
actions.description: The fire giant summons the essence of fire and shoots out a line of flame 1 unit wide and 10 units long, dealing fire damage to anyone within the area. This ability can only be used once per turn.

actions.name: Attack of Opportunity
actions.description: In response to a creature leaving it's area of control, the fire giant uses the Flaming Zweihander action against them.

actions.name: Raging Flames
actions.description: In response to taking damage from a melee weapon, the fire giant wreathes itself in flames, becoming ignited. While ignited in this way, any creature that begins it's turn adjacent to the fire giant takes 3d10 fire damage and also becomes ignited.

traits.name: Elemental
traits.description: Elementals have special protection against physical damage from weapons and ammunition that do not have the magical property, halving any damage before mitigations are applied.

traits.name: Unyielding
traits.description: The fire giant is a massive creature that is immutable and cannot be displaced.
